name: campusync
description: Orchestration for running every CampuSync backend service together in development - see README for details.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,USER,EVENTS,OPPS,CERT,VAULT,AI,MOCKTEST,NOTIF" -c "cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta,red,cyanBright,greenBright,yellowBright,blueBright" "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix services/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/user-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/events-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/opportunities-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/certification-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/document-vault-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/ai-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/mock-test-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/notification-service"
